title.narrative: Indicateur Doing Business (rang pays)

description.narrative: Indicateur Doing Business (rang pays)Taken from the LF, phrasing revised

comment.narrative: The unit is the distance frontier score which helps to assess the absolute level of regulatory performance over time. It measures the distance of each economy to the frontier which represents the best performance observed on each of the indicators across all economies in the Doing Business sample since 2005. One can both see the gap between a particular economys performance and the best performance at any point in time and assess the absolute change in the economys regulatory environment over time as measured by Doing Business. An economys distance to the frontier is reflectyed on a sample from 0 to 100 where 0 represents the lowest performance and 100 the frontier. For example a score of 75 in 2017 means an economy was 25 perentage points away from the frontier constructed from the best performances across all economies across time. A score of 80 in 2018 woiuld indicate that the economy is improving. Here the scores are presented as rang pays. As a baseline Benin has the rang of 155st country on the Dloing Business score.
Rang 130me pays en 2025 Source PND Page 27
51.42 en 2019 soit un rang de 153me paysPage 4 httpdocuments.worldbank.orgcurateden866751541064133401pdf131588WPDB2019PUBLICBenin.pdf
